name: Secured API key
description: Virtual Algolia API key derived from a main API key, generated with generateSecuredApiKey, not stored by Algolia and not shown in the dashboard.

blockers.summary: The construction is documented (HMAC then base64) but the length and alphabet of the result are not, and depend on the embedded parameters.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
